{{Short description|Concept in mathematics}}
A '''Lommel polynomial''' ''R''<sub>''m'',&nu;</sub>(''z'') is a polynomial in 1/''z'' giving the [[recurrence relation]] 
:<math>\displaystyle J_{m+\nu}(z) = J_\nu(z)R_{m,\nu}(z) - J_{\nu-1}(z)R_{m-1,\nu+1}(z) </math>
where ''J''<sub>&nu;</sub>(''z'') is a [[Bessel function]] of the first kind.<ref>{{cite journal |author=[[Eugen von Lommel]] |year=1871 |title=Zur Theorie der Bessel'schen Functionen |journal=Mathematische Annalen |volume=4 |issue=1 |pages=103–116 |publisher=Springer |place=Berlin / Heidelberg |doi=10.1007/BF01443302}}</ref>

They are given explicitly by
:<math>R_{m,\nu}(z) = \sum_{n=0}^{[m/2]}\frac{(-1)^n(m-n)!\Gamma(\nu+m-n)}{n!(m-2n)!\Gamma(\nu+n)}(z/2)^{2n-m}.</math>
